description: Say whether this send-only mailbox's sending service can tell us about bounces and complaints, whether that is on, the URL to give the service, and how many reports came in over the last 30 days by what became of them. We read mailgun, postmark, resend, sendgrid, ses. For Amazon SES it also says the topic, when AWS's subscription was confirmed, and the latest message we refused and why (`hook.refusal`). Never the secret. A mailbox with an inbox gets bounces as mail and has no hook. A key with `setup` can turn the hook on, replace its secret or turn it off. Without it, ask the owner with create_handoff (kind manage_report_hook, with this mailbox's id). A mailbox in another workspace answers 404.
name: get_mailbox_report_hook
title: Get a mailbox's report hook
